description: Cross-binding conformance for the CANDIDATE-GATED pathway of regridding/conservative_overlap.esm on exactly the dense exemplar's geometry (nine 1x1-degree source cells -> four 1.5x1.5-degree target cells tiling [0,3]x[0,3], planar manifold). The fixture runs the spatial-overlap broad phase -- the _gated narrow phase/assembly (conservative_overlap_*_gated) carry join.overlap{src_env:[src_poly], tgt_env:[tgt_poly]}, so the engine builds the candidate (i,j) set once at build time from the cell-ring bounding boxes (no hand-authored binning coordinate, no bin key, no bin-width parameter) -- then computes the DENSE path side by side on the same rings and gates VALUE-IDENTITY exactly: the inline test gated_equals_dense asserts the total L1 residual across A_ij/A_j/W_ij is 0.0 at tolerance abs 0.0 (bit-identical, not merely close: under the fixture's admissible binning the gated contraction visits the identical surviving set, and appending exact-zero terms to a nonnegative-area sum is FP-exact). On this compact tiling every cell's bounding box lies in [0,3]x[0,3] and the candidate set is the full 9x4 cross product; envelope candidacy never misses a genuine overlap (eps >= 0 is admissible by construction), so nothing prunes here -- automatic pruning on disjoint geometry is demonstrated by the sibling case conservative_overlap_gated_clusters_4_to_2. The two 5.8.3 EXACT invariants (partition-of-unity, conservation) gate the gated pipeline; the golden per-pair weights (official Julia runner via scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh, BuildInspection setup arrays A_ij/A_j/W_ij -- here the GATED matrices) must equal the dense exemplar conservative_overlap_3x3_to_2x2's committed golden numbers, the cross-case face of the same value-identity. reference_weights: see the dense exemplar's manifest (identical exact rationals: A_ij corner 1.0 / edge 0.5 / center 0.25 deg^2, A_j = 2.25, W corner 4/9 / edge 2/9 / center 1/9, F_tgt = [7/3, 11/3, 19/3, 23/3], mass 45).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator

tolerances._doc: Identical to the dense exemplar conservative_overlap_3x3_to_2x2 (same geometry, same 5.8 contract): sliver floor atol = area_atol_factor * characteristic_length^2; partition-of-unity exact by construction; conservation exact because the target tiles the source domain. The gated-vs-dense value identity is gated in-fixture at abs 0.0 (see tests), not here.
